text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day—while eating a late lunch in the cafeteria, I overheard cheerful voices coming from a nearby table.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ooh. So you decided on a day-trip hot spring for treating Pops?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Like, waters that are great for your skin? And I heard there are hidden hot springs up in the mountains too!
I wanna conquer every single one of 'em~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And then and then, I wanna eat tons of street food, and play air hockey at the game center!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
......I see.
By the way, Teio. Mind if I make a suggestion?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Let's call in some experts.

text_block_list.name: The Experts
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this a bit unreasonable?
Unreasonable... would be the word for this, yes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehh, you think so~? Pops always keeps up with me with stuff like this, you know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well yeah, I bet he does.
Why don't you try remembering really carefully what Pops looks like on those "always" occasions?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Pops, hurry, hurry~!
Let's go conquer that regional fair over there too~!

text_block_list.name: Pops
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *wheeze*, M-Milady...!
Please wait for meee... *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, what!? That's no good!
Pops is completely out of breath!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It needs to be a plan that actually suits Pops!
...Wait, what kind of plan suits Pops~!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Heheheh. That's exactly why I gathered them—an expert panel of grandpa's girls.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
First off, how about a change in direction?
Rather than running around all frantically, pick just one spot where you can take it slow and chill out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but wouldn't that be boring?
Since we're going, I wanna take him to all kinds of places.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You'd be surprised, actually.
My gramps always says just sitting still by the fishing pond is the best kind of time.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
My grandfather also prefers quiet over bustling crowds.
Settling down and concentrating on a single task... that is what he considers ideal.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Pops is an old man too after all...
Maybe his tastes really are totally different from mine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When in Rome, do as the Romans do, as the saying goes.
In my youth, my grandparents often admonished and disciplined me in such a manner.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
By nature, a hot spring resort town is a sanctuary to heal mind and body, not an amusement park.
Following its true purpose, perhaps a tranquil itinerary would be most fitting.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: If you're strolling through a hot spring town, you might wanna pay close attention to pacing too. Whenever I hang out with my grandma, that's what I care about the most.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh... I get it, I get it!
Then over here we'll do this, and...—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's doneee!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Instead of matching my pace, we'll go nice and slow at Pops' pace—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
............is what I came up with, but is going super-duper leisurely really gonna be okay?
Won't he get bored?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's totally fine, totally fine. It's just right.
I'm sure Pops is gonna love it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... You think so? I really hope so!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels like it needs one more little punch~.
Hey, what do you think, Trainer over there?
Like, something special you could only do on a chance like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the question was turned toward me.
What kind of gift would bring joy when given by a child who is practically like a grandchild...?
choice_data_list: How about writing a thank-you letter?
He wouldn't need anything at all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A thank-you letter...
Hrnngh... Isn't that, like...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Super embarrassing~??

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, he will surely treasure it.
A handwritten letter conveys genuine warmth, and I am certain Sir Pops will be moved all the more deeply.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You think...? Uuugh, hmmm...
I-I'll think about it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehh, you mean he wouldn't want anything from me at all!?
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just spending time with Teio-chan is the greatest gift... A physical present isn't even necessary...
That's classic grandfatherly affection right there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh, that's so boring!
Having a surprise present or something is definitely gonna make him happier~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her pure enthusiasm as she remained determined to give him something left a warm, heartwarming impression on me.
